LEGAL.PRIVACY_BODY:
Hemen-Go respects your privacy and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection rules.

  • We collect the data needed to create accounts, manage camper parking bookings, process configured payment methods, and send service communications.
  • Data is stored in a secure database and is only accessible to authorized staff and administrators responsible for the relevant parking area.
  • You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data by contacting the project team.
  • Local storage and cookies are used to keep the selected language and user session.

This policy applies only to the Hemen-Go booking application developed for this academic project.
LEGAL.TERMS_BODY:
By using Hemen-Go, you agree to use the application responsibly and to provide accurate information when creating bookings.

  • Bookings are subject to availability and may be rejected if the selected dates or spot are invalid.
  • Users are responsible for entering the correct license plate and stay dates.
  • Cancellations depend on the policy of the selected parking area.
  • Access control by license plate or QR code is a control feature and does not replace the internal rules of the establishment.
  • The project may contain test data and must not be used for real commercial operations without proper configuration.
